Ordinary human input and finite discovery supplies. All28 enemies, optionalclinic, three secrets and realroof departure. Accurateaim authoring evidence, not fresh-player or11minute acceptance.

states.name: low_water_arrival
states.note: Arrival faces the notice board and the market sightline in daylight. Upper row homes establish the town skyline.

states.name: arrival_rifle
states.note: Collect the guaranteed Rifle, finite bullets and armor through ordinary movement. Carried M03 gear is a separate local-run gate.

states.name: paint_locker_secret
states.note: The workshop's open doorway leads to the tram-paint locker and its competing-colour six. Secret shells are picked up normally.

states.name: notice_board_fight
states.note: A Clerk and two Sweepers enforce the notice. Their three named deaths and a physical arrival complete the first objective.

states.name: notary_lesson_observation
states.note: One Notary enters the empty square alone. The strip records context; the following probe waits for an actual committed photograph.

states.name: notary_lesson_defeat
states.note: The ordinary Rifle interrupts or punishes the dim-optic drone. Resolved phase captures establish its flash, launch and harmless crash independently of the timed observation strip.

states.name: street_mixed_advance
states.note: Two airborne Notaries and three grounded Sweepers pressure the open market loop. Future waves stay authoritatively staged.

states.name: clinic_switch
states.note: Open the one clinic shutter with its adjacent visible switch after the approach is clear. This optional action never gates the roof exit.

states.name: clinic_patient_release
states.note: Enter the opened clinic's care region. Authoritative patient feet begin their bounded walk through the actual doorway, without an escort timer or departure wait.

states.name: clinic_recovery
states.note: The clinic is bright and calm. Finite medical and Rifle supplies are obtained normally, with clear patient lanes beside the beds.

states.name: market_wave_a
states.note: First market-hold wave: three Sweepers, two Clerks and one Notary. Push among the cover islands rather than assuming their awnings protect against the sky.

states.name: market_recovery
states.note: Use the open northern lane to reach finite recovery without crossing a bench. The second wave begins at the western loop, not during this stop.

states.name: market_wave_b
states.note: Second market-hold wave: three Sweepers, one Clerk and one Notary. Both waves retain every authored defender, covering three market entrances.

states.name: repair_bench_supplies
states.note: The repair bench supplies Rifle ammunition, Shotgun, shells and health. They belong to this town's practical work area, not a reward menu.

states.name: awning_service_stairs
states.note: Climb the actual half-metre service treads to the noodle awnings. This proves the ordinary access route; the optional jumping line is not claimed by these walks.

states.name: awning_armor_secret
states.note: The six-marked roof pocket yields secret armor above the market. The pickup is reached through ordinary movement, without a grant or relocated camera.

states.name: awning_return
states.note: Return from the roof pocket through the real service stair. Water tanks and the court's far roof approach establish where the neighbours must go next.

states.name: court_watch_ground
states.note: The habitation court mixes two Notaries, four ground Sweepers and both balcony Clerks. Every attacking guard is eligible, and all eight named deaths are required.

states.name: court_balcony_clerks
states.note: Review the cleared court and balcony from ordinary ground movement after all eight named guards are confirmed dead. Physical arrival confirms the full six-objective prefix.

states.name: meal_table_secret
states.note: The shared meal table carries the carved six. The prototype medkit sits at its open edge beside the leg, because normal standing clearance does not permit literal under-table placement.

states.name: court_balcony_stairs
states.note: Seven ordinary half-metre steps reach the northern crossing before stepping down onto the accessible court balconies. The familiar water tank anchors the return planned for later levels.

states.name: court_roof_stairs
states.note: Finish the far-side roof stair with two further ordinary steps. All six required objective encounters are clear; clinic travel remains optional.

states.name: roof_departure
states.note: Use the roof control with the living ready party aboard. This isolated tour ends at the confirmed departure toward M05.
